data_points.source_name: MFDS (Korea Ministry of Food and Drug Safety) press release, 2025-05-27 -- 2024 cosmetics production and export statistics (record high)
data_points.methodology: Two-year same-table derivation from MFDS cosmetics-by-type production table (page 8 of the press release PDF), row: baby/infant products type (children age 3 and under). 2023 production KRW 83.8bn (83,800,000,000) -> 2024 production KRW 89.0bn (89,000,000,000). YoY = (890-838)/838 = +6.21%. Both years read from the same table in the same fetched document -- one source_url covers both.
data_points.notes: SCOPE CAVEAT: PRODUCTION basis (factory-gate output value), not retail sell-through -- per rule 4 do not present as retail growth. USD equiv at pinned USD/KRW 1478.40: 2023 approx US 56.68mn, 2024 approx US 60.20mn (via fx tool). Source is MFDS official type classification (13 cosmetic types under Korean cosmetics law); PDF mirrored via KCIA industry association but content is the unmodified official MFDS press release.
